name: Elastic App Search
tagline: Search functionality with Elastic App Search service

readme.overview: > **Important Note**: As confirmed in Elastic's official resources ([Enterprise Search FAQ](https://www.elastic.co/resources/search/enterprise-search-faq) and [9.x Upgrade Guide](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/enterprise-search/8.18/upgrading-to-9-x.html)) Standalone App Search is deprecated (fully removed in 9.x). For Elastic customers who currently use Elastic App Search product line with its included features and functionalities, these products remain available in the latest 8.x versions and will be maintained until January 15, 2027 and supported until July 15, 2027 after the official EOL announcement, according to our EOL policies. Virto Commerce will discontinue support for legacy App Search and transition all development efforts to the new [Elasticsearch 9 module](https://github.com/VirtoCommerce/vc-module-elastic-search-9).
keyFeatures: Fulltext Search Provider compatible with Elastic App Search version 8.12 and above.
Dynamic Boosting Concatenation: The provider combines dynamic boosting with query and static boosting from the Search Relevance Tuning panel.

notes.forAnalyst: Search through Elastic App Search's managed relevance tuning.
notes.forArchitect: A Search adapter with one setting and two permissions of its own — relevance is tuned in the service, not in code.
notes.forDeveloper: Useful when a merchandiser should tune search without a release; the trade is that tuning lives outside your repository.
reachForItWhen: This engine is the one your infrastructure already runs or your hosting provides
Search behaviour or scale has outgrown the current provider
You need the provider's own features — synonyms, analysers, vector search
doNotReachForItWhen: Two providers at once: the platform binds one at a time
You want to change what is indexed — that is the owning module's document builder
The problem is stale results: that is indexation, not the engine
